provenance.query_definition: post-RoPE q after q_norm, captured at every attention layer, pooled over the g=n_q_heads/n_kv_heads query heads that share a KV head (a key is shared by the whole GQA group). Q0 = (1/N) sum_q q q^T, UNCENTERED (LIT-020).
provenance.splithalf_definition: QA rows split by eval element id parity (disjoint documents)
provenance.bound_definition: one extra cartridge slot with post-RoPE key k receives, holding all other logits fixed, mass(q;k)=sigmoid(q.k/sqrt(d)-lse(q)) where lse(q) is the logsumexp over the 512 existing cartridge slots and the visible causal prefix; for m keys, mass=sigmoid(logsumexp_j(q.k_j/sqrt(d))-lse(q)).
